rows.name: image
rows.content: Picture shown in the left column. Optional.

rows.name: text
rows.content: Rich text: optional eyebrow paragraph (e.g. 'Nubank'), heading, description/date paragraph, optional CTA link in its own paragraph.

contentPattern.notes: Two single-cell rows. The row holding a picture becomes .hero-split-media; all other non-empty rows are merged into .hero-split-content. Paragraphs before the heading get .hero-split-eyebrow; a paragraph holding only a link gets .hero-split-cta.

usage: Split hero or intro banner without a form: image on the left, eyebrow + heading + description (or validity date) on the right. Default is the large page hero (legal/regulation pages); alt and purple are compact banners with a smaller image, purple adding a dark background and an outlined CTA link.
reuseGuidance: Use for image + text heroes/banners that have no signup field. If the hero contains the CPF/CNPJ signup card use hero-signup instead.
